_comment: Machine-readable link between a ChartFanatics strategy card and its EA. Read by chartfanatics/gen_todos.py (board + card Tracking fields) and by humans deploying the files. Magic block 3201-3247 is reserved for this family; keep it in sync with docs/EA_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACKER.md.

primitives: custom NQ-vs-ES SMT divergence (engine SMT is DXY-RSI)
custom fib-anchored OTE limit 0.62-0.705 + ADR gate
custom failed-raid detector (SigSessionFade timing does not fit)

local tick-volume profile (POC / value area / LVN)

Beacon 30/50/70 levels on the band-peak leg

volume confirmation vs the M1 average

rejection-candle entry with a stop beyond the setup candle
DNA zone scan (H1 base + exploded move, zone not line, consumed-level test)
aggression proxy (displacement body on above-average participation, close out of the zone)
relative-volume catalyst proxy + cfg.newsFilter calendar gate
cfg.partial1AtR partial into the first reaction

speed + streak displacement detection with the panic-candle path
capitulation-extreme stop with a risk cap

trendline through the pullback anchors with the measured move projected from the structure extreme
local Bollinger context (the doc's stretch reading)
daily report card from the deal history (mechanical mistake list, no judgement)
five-whys prompt file for the week's top recurring mistake
trade grading A+/A/B/C with the doc's allocation-band audit

one-playbook gate on the week's magic count
ungraded rows instead of a guessed R

eas.strategy: Nasdaq ICT and Order Flow Scalping Strategy
primitives: H4 macro structure (higher highs/lows) with the D1 EMA200 sanity check and the fair-value pullback band
H1 secondary-structure weakness: lower highs, a close below the previous high, sell-side volume dominance
IFBG entry: liquidity taken above a high, a fair value gap, then a close with volume below the gap
change-of-character entry (preferred): sweep, break with volume, failed retest close
break-and-retest continuation entry with a fair value gap displacing the level
orderflow proxy: session POC from tick-volume bins, VWAP, body-direction aggression, absorption failure
tight-stop cap in M1 ATR that skips wide setups
liquidity-pool target (session extreme / prior day) with an R floor
flip exit and sketchy-market capital-preservation exit in Manage()
per-bar session-flow cache (Manage runs every tick)

eas.strategy: NQ Liquidity Sweep & Reversal Scalping Strategy
primitives: EST kill-zone windows (London 02:00-05:00, New York 09:30) on the document's fixed UTC-5 clock
liquidity sweep of the Asia range (SigAsianRange) or a recent swing extreme
inverted fair value gap entry: a counter-directional gap closed through by a fresh trigger candle
session stop caps in index points (London 25 / New York 40) with the document's rejection quote
HTF liquidity-pool targets (Asia range, daily and 1H FVG edges, RTH gap quarters, midnight open) with a 2R floor
RTH gap built from the 16:00 EST close and the 09:30 EST open, quarters in the document's marks
confluence count (Asia sweep, daily FVG sweep, 1H FVG fill, equal-highs/lows run, displacement)
LotsMultiplier: A+ full risk, B/C 0.40x (= 5 vs 2 contracts)
1H-FVG half-close and minor-sweep trail in Manage()
dollar-based daily loss limit as a percentage of the account
premium as maximum risk: money at risk (EA_LossPerLotAllIn x volume) audited per position against a budget
no-stop positions flagged as having no defined premium (the writers' risk the document warns about)
theta: holding times from the entry deal to the exit deal, audited against the trader's style horizon (day / swing)
liquidity as fill quality: EA_SlipMedianR and the scope's spread baseline against budgets
volatility-crush analogue: the day's range vs its own median at entry time (no IV feed exists for a CFD)
sizing: the day's peak deployed risk against the deployment cap
daily study sheet CSV plus a five-tenets PASS/FLAG card
live risk registry snapshot and a final one on deinit
BuildPlan returns false - the monitor never trades

four criteria: market-generated levels (D1 previous high/low, the overnight range 02:00-14:29 London, the 30-minute ORB), the 70% value area and low volume nodes from a tick-volume profile, big-trade prints, and delta / absorption
range model: value-area edge entries, tight stop, midpoint-first structure, opposite edge as the final target
trap fade: a wick through a generated level that closes back inside, sold into the breakout traders
trend model: pullbacks into low volume nodes after an accepted value break, next generated level or measured extension as the target
at least 2 of 4 criteria required; 3+ = A+ sizing via LotsMultiplier
never the middle of a range, never against momentum
first 1-3 hours post-open only (09:30-12:30 ET = 14:30-17:30 London), max 3 trades a day
never let a winner go red: 1R partial + break-even, trail, lower-highs structure exit
Context gate: a real push (ImpulseContext) before any level can be defended
Location gate: documented levels (previous day high/low, session extreme, value-area edges / POC, repeated-touch levels via TouchCount)
Confirmation gate: absorption (heavy volume, no progress, rejection wick, control flip) and the delta divergence proxy
stop run and reclaim: a flush through the level, then the reclaim close, with the structural stop beyond the flush low
target: the rotation to the session's far extreme with a minimum R floor
LotsMultiplier hook for the 4-5-touch levels the case study names
no engine partial / break-even / trail (the document states no management rules)

three core components as one gate: size of the move from the last 20-day-MA base (cap-tier percentage), acceleration of the leg (range expansion or session gaps, shallow pullbacks), and the exhaustion day within two days of the top
exhaustion day: below VWAP and unable to reclaim it, lower highs and lower lows from real pivots
three graded entries: structure break, structure + VWAP loss together, and the failed VWAP reclaim
stop at the high of the day or the most recent lower high, with the playbook's partial + break-even
the risk-free add: a second short only when the banked partial profit covers the add risk
expected-move target with the already-moved skip filter
close before the end of the day; exit when VWAP is reclaimed strongly
H1 trend from successive pivot highs and lows (higher highs + higher lows / lower highs + lower lows)
H1 levels at the pivot candle OPEN price, confidence-scored 5/5, 3/5 or 2.5/5
confidence-based position sizing through LotsMultiplier (full / half / quarter risk)
three M5 candle patterns: break and retest, bounce, rejection (with the optional M2 alignment)
stops at the pattern wick; target 2R (1.5R floor) capped by the next level
50% trim at 2R with the stop shifted above entry, a second trim, and the candle-by-candle trail
two attempts per setup from the day deal history; 2-3 trades a day; one-and-done after a win
one-hour execution window after the open, session-end flat, EA_ApplyStagePolicy

eas.strategy: Price Cycle Continuation & Failed Base Strategy
primitives: long side (bullish cycle): established uptrend (rising 50 EMA, price over the 200 EMA), a tight base on receding volume, the breakout above the base with volume, or the pullback into the 10/20-day EMAs
long scaling: 1/3 at 2x ADR profit, 1/3 at 8-10x ATR from the 50-day EMA, the final 1/3 trailed on the 10/20-day EMA and exited on violation
stock selection: $50M average daily dollar volume, 3%+ ADR, relative strength versus a market proxy

short side (failed base): the base whose breakout failed, the 20-EMA violation on larger volume, the minimal-volume wedge to a lower high, the turn lower with the stop above the high of day, market confirmation
short covers: half on the undercut and rally, the rest on the 10-day EMA reclaim
daily context on D1, entries timed on M5 (the document two timeframes)
